steps.note: Eggs set a baked cheesecake, while an unbaked one is set with cream or gelatin.
The filling goes onto a crumb or pastry base in the pan.

steps.name: bake
steps.note: Baked in a water bath until the edge is set and the middle still wobbles, at about 65 °C inside.
It cools in the switched-off oven with the door ajar, so it does not crack.
It is chilled for at least 6 hours.

processing.text: The baking figures are from a cream cheese recipe, as no quark recipe was opened; Wikipedia lists quark among the cheeses used.

sources.text: The filling, base and baked or unbaked styles are from Wikipedia, and the oven, water bath, doneness and chilling from the recipe.
